notes:
Summary: mid-market SaaS (customer support platform) evaluating Redwood Hosted API initially, moving toward Dedicated for predictable peak throughput. Team is engineering-led (CTO + Head of Product) with procurement + infosec heavily involved now.

POC highlights / customer comments:
- "Hosted API integrated in 48h, fast to test; reranking results look promising" (Head of Product)
- p95 latency target: ~150ms for short-chat paths, acceptable up to 300ms for heavy context.
- Cost sensitivity: wants clear unit economics for token-heavy features; CFO asks for 12-month TCO scenario.

Workshop takeaways (initial):
- Batching: combining multi-user latency windows reduced per-token overhead in POC; recommended dynamic batching with 15-25ms micro-wait for chat to improve throughput during peaks.
- Caching: prefix + KV cache for knowledge retrieval yielded ~30% token reduction on queries hitting docs cache. Identify top 200 queries for aggressive prefix caching.
- Quantization: SE demoed 4-bit and 8-bit profiles; 4-bit QAT (quant-aware tuning) gave ~2.2x cost improvement with <1.5% quality delta on reranking benchmarks.
- Unit economics: rough projection provided — hosted baseline $0.45 per 1k tokens (POC) -> with batching+caching+4-bit could drop to $0.18-$0.22 per 1k equivalent on steady state. Dedicated reserved capacity pricing discussed as next step.

Open items:
- Need full security questionnaire answers (SEC-1199).
- Procurement requires 2 comparable vendor quotes for Dedicated capacity (they named OpenAI + Anthropic).
- Legal: data residency clause for EU customers (customer serves EU clients).

Quote request: engineering requested detailed Dedicated SKU breakdown (gpu type, slots, expected throughput) + example billing cadence for burst usage.

Stance: enthusiastic but pragmatic—will sign if Dedicated pilot proves 40%-60% improvement in unit economics vs Hosted and security checklist cleared.
requirements_summary: Workload: mixed chat + document search + reranking. Latency: target p95 150ms for standard chat flows, 250-300ms max for heavy contexts. Throughput: 300-1200 qps during peak windows (support chat bursts). Cost sensitivity: mid-high (needs 12-month TCO). Model preference: open model variants (Llama-family style) with option for Redwood-verified quantized profiles; prefer ability to route to cheaper variants during non-peak. Routing/fallback: auto-fallback to smaller quantized variant when Dedicated pool saturated. Compliance: SOC2 + SSO/SAML, KMS, audit logs, EU data residency for subset of customers.
recent_poc_metrics: Hosted API baseline: p50 65ms, p95 310ms (batching off). With initial batching+cache patch: p95 190ms, token burn -28%. 4-bit quant profile trial: model quality drop ~1.2% on rerank NDCG, cost down ~2.2x. Dedicated projection: target p95 130-160ms with 30-60% lower unit cost depending on reserved commit.
decision_criteria: 1) Unit economics improvement >=40% vs Hosted at expected scale; 2) Security questionnaire sign-off (SOC2 + KMS + residency); 3) Pilot proves latency SLOs at p95; 4) Clear pricing & commitment terms for Dedicated (burst allowance).
